headline: Here we go! Declan Rice to its_ohi
deck: its_ohi get Declan Rice from Truffles for Bruno Fernandes
body:
its_ohi land Declan Rice from Truffles, the Arsenal midfielder good for 48 points this season without a goal to his name. Truffles take Bruno Fernandes the other way, the Manchester United man sat on 34 points and three goals. A straight midfield swap, no further business attached.

Here we go!
